voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: September nineteen seventy-nine. A satellite saw a double flash over the Indian Ocean. Hours later in Puerto Rico, the Arecibo radio telescope recorded a ripple high in the atmosphere.
Moving in an unusual direction. Underwater microphones caught sounds a Navy laboratory linked to a blast at sea.
Weeks later, sheep in Australia were found carrying iodine one thirty-one, a product of nuclear fission.
In nineteen eighty, a panel for the White House judged it probably not nuclear. Many government scientists disagreed.
None of it settled the question. No government has ever confirmed what it was.
